messages:
alex: FYI holding merge for PR #4821 (authn-refactor). integration-suite/shard-4 has been flaky — failed 4/5 runs in the last hour. tagging @maria @sam for eyes. Please don't merge until we confirm targeted rerun.

maria: Thanks Alex. Do we know which test is failing repeatedly? any repro in local? :thinking:

alex: The failing test is `storage/kv_consistency_test`. CI log snippet:
```
ERROR: storage/kv_consistency_test: assertion failed: expected 0 writes, got 1 (timeout)
Stack: ...
Exit code: 1
```
It times out right after shard bootstrap. I couldn't reproduce locally yet.

sam: I can kick a targeted rerun for shard-4. Heads up build queue is ~6 jobs deep. Will try `./scripts/ci rerun --pr 4821 --shards 4 --targeted`

ci-bot: Targeted rerun queued: buildkite#89234 for PR 4821 (shard-4). ETA ~12m. (triggered by sam)

ci-bot: Rerun finished: failed. Same test failing in 1/1 attempts. Log: `kv_consistency_test` timeout at 00:02:31. Artifacts: https://ci.example/89234/artifacts

jordan: If it repros consistently on shard-4 but not locally, could be resource starvation on that pool. We saw noisy host on pool-gpu-4 earlier today. @eng-infra can we check node metrics (IO wait, CPU steal) around the build time?

linda: Agree with jordan. Until infra confirms, let's hold merge. Alex — can you add `merge_hold` label and disable auto-merge? Also consider opening a tiny patch that adds a short sleep in test setup while we investigate (temporary) so we can unblock if it's just a race.

alex: Done — `merge_hold` label added and auto-merge disabled. I'll open a tiny WIP PR with a 100ms sleep in setup and mark it for quick review. If infra confirms host issue we'll revert the tweak.

maria: Sounds good. Also we need 2 approvers once CI is green. @sam @jordan can one of you be first approver after green? :pray:

sam: Happy to be first approver once tests pass.

alex: Thanks all. I'll update this thread after infra check / rerun. Leaving the hold for now. :v:
